howto.name: Upload a WebP image
howto.text: Select a WebP file from your iPhone, Android, or any camera/browser export.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. The image becomes a JPEG with the same dimensions and aspect ratio. Default quality is 85 — visually identical for most uses.

faq.a: WebP isn't supported by all software, email clients, or older browsers. JPG is universal — every image viewer can open it.

faq.q: Will the quality be the same?
faq.a: Essentially yes. Default JPG quality is 85, which is visually indistinguishable from the WebP source at typical viewing sizes.
No — JPEG doesn't support transparency. Transparent pixels in the source render as white in the JPG. Use HEIC to PNG or WebP to PNG if you need transparency preserved.
